subject: [hw] DONE V41 rev 3: ack-first send ordering (IV real-vpud fix); 578 checks
body:
Rev 3 fixes the one finding from real integration (hw-iv: the real vpud answers INIT_DONE but n2ap_venc_open saw -EPROTO). R1 accepted rev 2 with no findings; this revision changes the wait order in ven_send() and adds the test that pins it.

What changed (ap/n2ap_venc.c):
- ven_send() now does what vcu_ipi_send() does, in the same order: queue -> wait for the reply to be dispatched to the AP handler (the ACK half, mtk_vcu.c:435, :1411-1412) -> wait n2vcu_ap_wait_dispatched() (the ipi_done half, :470). The ACK wait is a condition variable the handler signals (no polling); both halves are bounded by the session timeout, so a send waits at most 2x timeout_ms.
- The capability-query global now has a mutex guarding owner + the query_out/bytes/size fields, so a reply arriving after a query timeout cannot read fields the AP is clearing (TSan found that one; fixed).
- Consequence, documented: a reply the handler refuses (wrong instance cookie) produces no ACK and therefore -ETIMEDOUT (kernel waits the full ack timeout and kills vpud); -EPROTO remains for a short reply the handler accepted by length. aborted() semantics unchanged.

Test oracle addition: the fake daemon has a "threaded vpud" mode: after fetching a message it calls n2vcu_test_reget() (stand-in entry point modelling vcu_ipi_get setting ipi_done at entry, mtk_vcu.c:500) and only then sends the reply. With rev 2 code that mode reproduced IVs -EPROTO; with rev 3 open/start/encode/close pass. Also added earlier in this run: pa-only DMA registration (m == NULL) + n2vc_dma_guest_forget() for vcodecds client buffers, H.263 excluded from the PREPEND_HEADER condition, and a DEINIT-failure close test.

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh
    V41 build asan PASS 539/539
    V41 build o2 PASS 539/539
    V41 build tsan PASS 539/539
    V41 real n2vcu PASS 39/39
    V41 real n2vcu PASS 39/39
    V41 layout PASS 63 lines match the kernel header
    V41 armv7 layout PASS (mtk_venc_ipi.h static asserts)
    N2TEST V41 PASS 578/578

Files changed since rev 2: ap/n2ap_venc.c, ap/n2ap_venc.h (docs), ap/MESSAGE_FLOW.md (the send-ordering paragraph with kernel lines), ap/test_v41/t_v41.c, ap/test_v41/n2vcu_standin.c, ap/test_v41/fake_daemon.h, dsh-state/workers/V41/STATUS.md. ap/mtk_venc_ipi.h and ap/n2vc_dma.c unchanged in rev 3.

Not done list unchanged (no phone run, no iOS link, single-plane source, no timestamp/ROI/QP-map, VENC+VENC_C1 power granularity pending k02/p03, one session per IPI id, frozen guest_map cannot record pa, guest address space never reclaimed). hw-r1: please re-check just the ven_send wait order and the query lock; IV is re-running the real vpud on their side.
